sources.title: [2309.14717] QA-LoRA: Quantization-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation of Large ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a quantization-aware low-rank adaptation (QA-LoRA) algorithm. The motivation lies in the imbalanced degrees of freedom of quantization and adaptation, and the solution is to use group-wise operators which increase the degree of freedom of quantization meanwhile decreasing that of adaptation.

sources.title: Qa-lora: Quantization-aware low-rank adaptation of large language ...
sources.snippet: QA-LoRA proposes a quantization-aware approach that integrates quantization constraints directly into the LoRA training process. By balancing the number of parameters between quantization and adaptation, it mitigates the imbalanced parameter issue that can cause training instability.
